entities.summary: Chola, a notable figure in the history of India, associated with Regional Kingdoms and Temple Age (850–1279). Preceded by Chola Maritime Empire and Deccan and South Indian Dynasties. Their legacy influenced Razia Sultana rules as the only female sovereign of the Delhi Sultanate.
